title: Scoped STYLE1071 font projection and XDATA preservation

sources.role: Primary implementation source screen: ACAD1000 font family plus1071 flags, including an empty family; notes that these metadata do not establish reliable rendering. Mutable URL; no pinned peer/native execution or font-rendering qualification.

scope: DXF STYLE1071 body versus ACAD extended-font versus arbitrary application integers. Preserve LibreCAD font projection, ordered XDATA and public model/callback layouts; keep edited font output consistent through a borrowed nonmutating overlay. Selected original source profiles, integer output spans, readback and atomic same-adapter retries are verified. No native DWG layout/parser, font rendering, full recursive/live/output closure or external semantic qualification is claimed.

implementation.readerRouting: Bare1071 before XDATA keeps the existing body projection. Every1071 after an APPID is retained through the ordinary TableEntry parser and node budget. Only immediate ACAD1071 legacy prefix or ACAD1000/1071 canonical prefix additionally projects into fontFamily, after the ordinary append succeeds. Subsequent or custom-APPID integers do not overwrite it.
implementation.parserState: At most two-tag lookbehind in the existing ordered XDATA sequence; no new parser, model or reader/facade state and no new allocation for classification.
implementation.output: A linear scan selects a valid recognized ACAD flag; the existing generic XDATA validator/emitter borrows a constant1071 fontFamily overlay for that pointer and every other original pointer unchanged. Input data and variant representation remain unmodified. Null, invalid-type and out-of-range original flags cannot be masked.
implementation.selectedSourceInventory: Body1071 duplicate checks are separate from legal repeated XDATA integers. Independently identify canonical ACAD1000/1071, decode bounded escaped APPIDs, and require body/ACAD agreement when both exist. Bare-ACAD projection compatibility and conflicting metadata remain unqualified.
implementation.writerTargets: Eight supported DXF revisions retain their existing contract. AC1012 remains a refused public writer target with destination-preserving same-adapter corrected retries.

allocationSchedule.scope: STYLE writing callback; same adapter corrected export/readback after every scheduled offset

retainedFailures: Initial -Werror misleading-indentation compile errors were corrected with braces/newlines; warning policy unchanged.
Original bug reproduced: a custom APPID1071 sequence overwrote fontFamily with -1234567 and lost retained integers instead of preserving body5570578 and ordered XDATA.
Expanded legacy recipe initially copied body1071 into extData before APPID; the writer correctly rejected malformed XDATA. Recipe now starts at the first APPID.
AC1012 was initially expected to export, but the existing supported-writer whitelist excludes it. Keep a negative destination/retry control; supported legacy readbacks remain positive.

validation.scope: Affected integration cohort, not a full test suite.
